title: Answer: will is real and causal, not free of causes

statements.text: There is a will, and it is real: it is the brain field's influence on the neurons that drive voluntary action. It is not free in the sense of acausal, and agency is the experience of that field-located mind acting on the world.

sources.quote: though this EM field-driven will is not free, in the sense of being acausal, it nevertheless corresponds to the very real experience of our conscious mind being in control of our voluntary actions
